content_text: Depends on your day exterior situation — most of the time, the headroom on the Alexa at ISO 800 is fine. But I suppose you may have a scene where everyone is dressed in white on a sunny day or the camera is pointed into the ocean with hot sunlight glaring off of it where you may want a bit more headroom, but keep in mind that higher ISO means more noise.
